redevelopment.a: It depends on approvals and building size. We share a timeline with the committee before the agreement is signed.

redevelopment.q: What consent is needed from members?
redevelopment.a: Under Section 79A guidelines, a general body resolution passed with the required majority of members.

redevelopment.q: Which societies are you redeveloping now?
redevelopment.a: Sai Nidhi CHS Ltd. (Deep Crown, Nalasopara West) and Laxmiben Chheda CHSL (Deep Landmark, Nalasopara East).
Terms such as additional area, rent and corpus are agreed with each society. Request a feasibility meeting to discuss your building.

contact.q: Can I visit a project site?
contact.a: Yes. Book a site visit and our team will fix a time that suits you.
